title: Phase 56D: Derive COD from construction start and duration
type: runtime UI + safe backend derivation / draft-only

files_changed.note: Adds _parse_iso_date, _derive_cod_date, _read_optional_form_fields, _apply_56d_extras_to_submitted helpers. _apply_new_project_required_inputs extended to write spv_name, currency, construction_start_date, construction_duration_months. Route body slim (60-110 lines pinned by 51M-2).
cod_date input made readonly, required removed. .np-derived-note block added explaining server-side derivation.
Appended .np-derived-note, .np-derived-note__label, .np-derived-note__text, input[readonly], input[aria-readonly=true] blocks. No :root changes; count remains 5.
New test file with 10 test classes (52 tests).
New design + scope + visual-review checklist doc.

new_helpers.name: _parse_iso_date
new_helpers.purpose: Parse ISO-8601 date string YYYY-MM-DD. Returns None on missing/malformed.

new_helpers.name: _derive_cod_date
new_helpers.purpose: Derive COD from start + duration using dateutil.relativedelta. Returns YYYY-MM-DD string or None.

new_helpers.name: _read_optional_form_fields
new_helpers.purpose: Read raw body via await request.body() + urllib.parse.parse_qs. Bypasses await request.form() (forbidden by 51M-1).

new_helpers.name: _apply_56d_extras_to_submitted
new_helpers.purpose: Merge 4 extra form fields into submitted. Always assigns server-derived COD when derivable (ignores manual cod_date in form body). Manual override is NOT supported in 56D (deferred).

cod_derivation_policy.manual_override: NOT supported in 56D (deferred). Derived COD always wins when start+duration are valid; manually supplied cod_date in form body is ignored.

coverage_areas: Inline form: cod_date is readonly, not required, label mentions derivation
Inline form: .np-derived-note block exists with start + duration + COD language

_apply_56d_extras_to_submitted: uses _derive_cod_date, pulls 4 extras, substitutes derived COD when empty

Scope guardrails: app.js, waterfall_core, project_factories, runtime_impact_taxonomy, persistence unchanged
Helper determinism pinned for normal / month-end / leap-year
